transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. I came in because... well, I just keep feeling like I’ve really let my family down. We took on this mortgage recently, and I can't shake the feeling that it's all my fault and I've messed everything up for them. 

It's getting to the point where every small mistake I make at work—I wait tables—just proves to me that I’m completely useless. I just have this constant feeling that I deserve whatever bad things happen to me, and I needed to talk to someone about it.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the day?

Yeah, I have. Most days, honestly. There's just this... heavy, empty feeling in my chest. It's like I'm just going through the motions at the restaurant. I carry the plates and I smile at the customers, but it's only because I'm supposed to, you know? Not because I actually feel anything good. It just kind of stays with me most of the day.
How long have you been feeling this low most days?
I'd say it's been about a year and two months now. That's how long these periods of feeling so down and guilty have been going on.
Did these feelings of depression begin within a few months after taking on the mortgage or another specific stressful event?

No, not really. I mean, we just took out the mortgage a few months ago, but I've been feeling this way for over a year. So, the timing doesn't really line up like that. There wasn't really any specific stressful event that kicked it off, it just kind of started.
During the past year and two months, have you had any period lasting at least two months when you felt mostly back to normal?

No, I don't think so. I haven't really had any time where I felt back to normal for that long. It's just been a constant low, you know? I haven't caught a break from it for two months straight, not at all.
During this period, have you felt unusually tired or low in energy most days?

No, I wouldn't really say so. I mean, I work as a waiter, so I'm on my feet all day and get regular tired from that, but... I haven't felt unusually low on energy or anything. It's really just my mood that's been down, rather than feeling physically exhausted all the time.
Have you noticed any change in your sleep since you began feeling depressed?

No, my sleep hasn't really changed. I mean, I still get about the same amount of rest every night. I haven't been sleeping too much or having trouble falling asleep, so... yeah, that's stayed pretty normal.
Have you had difficulty concentrating or making decisions during this period?

Yeah, actually, I have. At work, I'm having trouble keeping numbers straight on the POS system and the inventory sheets. I mean, I've done this job for years, but lately I'll just stare at the screen... I know how to do it, but I just don't trust what I just entered. It's like I can't focus enough to be sure I did it right.
During this period, have you lost interest in or stopped enjoying activities that you usually like?

No, I wouldn't say so. I mean, I still enjoy the things I usually do. Like, when I have a day off, I still like watching a game or... you know, just hanging out with friends. I haven't really stopped doing any of the stuff I like.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite since you began feeling depressed?

Yeah, my eating has been kind of all over the place lately. Um, some weeks I barely even touch the staff meal at work. But then other nights, I'll get home from a shift and just eat whatever's in the kitchen... I don't know, just to feel settled, I guess. So it's definitely been pretty inconsistent.
Have other people noticed that you are moving or speaking more slowly than usual?

Yeah, they actually have. Some of the other servers have pointed it out. Sometimes I'm just pacing around, checking the same tables and receipts over and over again, like I can't stop moving. But then other times, I just get so slowed down. Like, just grabbing menus and walking over to the POS system takes me way longer than it normally would. So, yeah, people have definitely noticed.
How much have these symptoms interfered with your ability to do your job or manage your relationships?

It's definitely been getting in the way. Um, at work, I've had a few near-missed shifts, and I'm just having a lot more trouble keeping up with the POS reports and inventory. It's stressful because I've also been making mistakes with my mortgage paperwork at home... and I just worry a lot that if I keep slipping up, I could lose my job and then end up losing my condo. 

And as for relationships, I guess I've really pulled back from my brother, and I keep to myself a lot more around my coworkers. It's gotten to the point where people have definitely started noticing that I'm just not myself lately.
